title: Curiously
summary: CURIOUSLY, adverb 1. With nice inspection; inquisitively; attentively. I saw nothing at first, but observing it more curiously the spots appeared. 2. With nice care and art; exactly; neatly; elegantly

inlines.v: CURIOUSLY, adverb 1. With nice inspection; inquisitively; attentively. I saw nothing at first, but observing it more curiously the spots appeared. 2. With nice care and art; exactly; neatly; elegantly. Psalms 139:15. 3. In a singular manner; unusually.
